name: Christmas with the Critters at Cameron Park Zoo
when_note: Doors open at 5:45 pm; the evening ends with entry to Wild Lights at 7:30 pm.
paras: Cameron Park Zoo runs Christmas with the Critters from December 17 to 23, 2026, at 1701 N. 4th St. The zoo's education team leads a hands-on session on animal enrichment, and guests make a gift of enrichment for the zoo's animal ambassadors or other residents. Hot cocoa and cookies are included.

Tickets are $35 for adults and $25 for children ages 3 to 13, and each adult ticket includes a ceramic commemorative ornament. Doors open at 5:45 pm, the animal encounter runs until 7 pm, and the evening ends with admission to Wild Lights at 7:30 pm.
tip: Buy tickets through the zoo's ticket page ahead of time, since this is a program with its own tickets rather than regular zoo admission.

name: ACW Family Day: Winter Wonderland at Art Center Waco
paras: Art Center Waco hosts Winter Wonderland, its last free Family Day of 2026, on Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to 1 pm at 701 S. 8th St. Families can sip hot chocolate with marshmallows, get festive face painting, meet rescue dogs and watch live artist demonstrations.
Hands-on art activities are open to the whole family. Art Center Waco also uses the morning to give a sneak peek of its 2027 art classes, special events and Summer Camp: Art Through the Eras.
tip: Plan for a morning visit, since the free Family Day runs only from 10 am to 1 pm.
